title: Homomorphisms and the isomorphism theorems
summary: Group homomorphisms, kernels and images; the kernel is a normal subgroup and every normal subgroup is a kernel; the first isomorphism theorem and the canonical factorisation; the second and third isomorphism theorems and the correspondence theorem; automorphisms.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is chapter 11 of Judson (Sections 11.1–11.2).

preparation.description: Read Section 11.1 (group homomorphisms, kernels, images) from the chapter page.
Read Section 11.2: the first isomorphism theorem (Theorem 11.2.1), the second (Theorem 11.2.3), the correspondence theorem (Theorem 11.2.4) and the third (Theorem 11.2.5).
Optional supplement: MIT student notes, lecture 5 (The Correspondence Theorem).
